clause: Design-system domain binding: studio.design_system command family + primitive layer bindings + engine boundary [STU-DS-001,STU-DS-035,STU-ARC-002]

scope.summary: Wire the handshake_core::studio::design_system domain to the studio-engine LayoutEngine (MT-020) through the typed boundary only: register the studio.design_system.<command>.v<N> command family over the MT-007 command surface, bind the canonical primitives StudioComponent/StudioComponentInstance/StudioVariable/StudioVariableCollection/StudioStyleRegistry/StudioAutoLayout/StudioConstraint/StudioLayoutGrid (MT-002) to StudioLayer nodes, and route every mutation through STUDIO_* EventLedger events (MT-003) + typed studio_* SurrealDB authority (MT-004). No solver/tessellation dependency leaks into handshake_core; auto-layout/constraint solving lives behind the LayoutEngine trait. PostgreSQL and SQLite are forbidden.
acceptance_criteria: studio.design_system command family routes through LayoutEngine boundary + EventLedger + typed SurrealDB authority; canonical primitives bound; no dependency leak; PostgreSQL/SQLite rejected
expected_tests: live: studio.design_system command mutation emits ledger event + lands in studio_* authority via PromotionGate
test: no solver/GPU dep leak into handshake_core; primitives bound to StudioLayer without forking types

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: No design-system domain wiring; all 14.10 MTs unroutable and unauditable.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
